label: conj:two-filtration-bridge-general
title: Two-filtration bridge map in full generality: bar-class determines iterated-integral depth (self-conj $\to$ 2, chiral pair $\to$ 3) for all partitions
html:
This conjecture extends the bridge map d_{\mathrm{II}} to all partitions of any n. It is conditional: it rests on Two-filtration bridge: iterated-integral depth \leftrightarrow partition-cellular GB-depth via e_\lambda, which defines d_{\mathrm{II}}, and on an unproved matching of the transposing involution \# on H_n(q) with orientation reversal on periods. The bar involution itself fixes every e_\lambda and does not separate \lambda from \lambda'.

What is proved. Cell-depth filtration of Z(H_n(q)), item 4, is the provable core: under two named hypotheses (H-match: \# is intertwined with orientation reversal by a realisation map \Phi; H-parity: orientation reversal acts on depth-d periods by (-1)^d), odd-depth components vanish on self-conjugate cells and are antisymmetric under \lambda\leftrightarrow\lambda'. It does not give the values 2 and 3, which need a further non-vanishing. Note also that the "otherwise" branch of the definition of d_{\mathrm{II}} in Two-filtration bridge: iterated-integral depth \leftrightarrow partition-cellular GB-depth via e_\lambda is empty, since every partition is either self-conjugate or half of the pair \{\lambda,\lambda'\}. So the boxed formula below restates that definition; the content of this conjecture is the existence of a realisation for which it is non-degenerate.

Statement

For every partition \lambda (of any n \geq 1), the iterated- integral depth predicted by the two-filtration bridge conjecture (Two-filtration bridge: iterated-integral depth \leftrightarrow partition-cellular GB-depth via e_\lambda) depends only on the bar-class of \lambda:

  \boxed{\;
    d_{\mathrm{II}}(\lambda)
    \;=\;
    \begin{cases}
      2 & \text{if } \lambda \text{ is self-conjugate } (\lambda = \lambda'), \\
      3 & \text{if } \{\lambda, \lambda'\} \text{ is a chiral pair } (\lambda \neq \lambda').
    \end{cases}
  \;}

Corollaries

Scope: the small-cases table at n \leq 4 is a comparison (the cell-to-knot assignment there is chosen, not derived), so it does not "extend" to all n; the general-n content is item 4 of Cell-depth filtration of Z(H_n(q)).

Corollary for the depth correspondence:

  • For each self-conjugate cell, its depth-2 row is conditional on the bridge conjecture (with Bloch–Suslin and the per-knot volume conjecture where available).
  • For each chiral pair, its depth-3 row is conditional on the CS computation per knot.

Cross-references

  • Proved core: Cell-depth filtration of Z(H_n(q))
  • Bridge conjecture: Two-filtration bridge: iterated-integral depth \leftrightarrow partition-cellular GB-depth via e_\lambda
  • Chirality structure: Chirality structure on Goncharov period classes via the bar involution
  • Hecke-Baer-* and bar action on e_\lambda: Iwahori--Hecke algebra H_n(q) is a Baer-*-ring at generic q, Explicit central primitive idempotents e_\lambda via Jucys–Murphy elements
